zRqnY9y7dMBKa-q1g1rUcw.zh: 哥倫比亞西部納里奧省(Nariño)自今年7/17起爆發腹瀉群聚疫情,迄今報告逾777例病例,無重症或死亡個案,疫情影響多處市區及鄉鎮,部份患者檢體檢出諾羅病毒。因嚴重乾旱,導致河川稀釋能力降低,加上家庭與工業廢水排入,造成自來水系統與河水遭受汙染,當局已發布警報並要求學校暫時停課。
zRqnY9y7dMBKa-q1g1rUcw.en: In Nariño Department in western Colombia, a diarrhoea cluster has been reported since 17 July this year, with more than 777 cases to date. No severe or fatal cases have been reported. The outbreak has affected multiple urban and rural areas, and norovirus was detected in some patient specimens. Severe drought has reduced the dilution capacity of rivers, and discharge of household and industrial wastewater has contaminated tap water systems and river water. Authorities have issued an alert and asked schools to suspend classes temporarily.

L5adHo7mOM3zpVydjYyC4g.zh: 哥倫比亞今年截至7/15累計報告202例病例,其中90例死亡(CFR: 44%),疫情以托利馬省(Tolima)為高,多數病例無接種疫苗,此波疫情係從2024年9月延續迄今,當局評估,本次疫情致死率偏高,主要與疫情擴散至新地區導致延誤診斷,以及與登革熱共同流行有關。另該國過往疫苗涵蓋率為64%(1-59歲族群)。
L5adHo7mOM3zpVydjYyC4g.en: As of 15 July this year, Colombia has reported 202 cases cumulatively, including 90 deaths (CFR: 44%). The outbreak is concentrated in Tolima Department, and most cases were unvaccinated. This wave has continued since September 2024. Authorities assess that the high fatality ratio in this outbreak is mainly related to the spread of the outbreak to new areas, which has delayed diagnosis, and to co-circulation with dengue. Vaccination coverage in the country was previously 64% (population aged 1 to 59 years).

nwM6Y02lkuPoAKIGv980hg.zh: 哥倫比亞疫情更新,2024年至2026年5/17累計10省報告192例病例及85例死亡,疫情傳播不再局限於托利馬省,已蔓延至其他省份,大部分重症及死亡病例無疫苗接種紀錄。
nwM6Y02lkuPoAKIGv980hg.en: Colombia outbreak update: from 2024 to 17 May 2026, 10 departments have reported 192 cumulative cases and 85 deaths. Transmission is no longer confined to Tolima Department and has spread to other departments. Most severe and fatal cases had no vaccination record.

TrNrnQecC4af-YR-nwzsMQ.zh: 每月更新:  全球自2022 年截至今年4/30 累計144 國/地區報告18 萬4,531例確診病例,其中,至少506例死亡。 非洲地區近6週(4/6-5/17)通報確診病例數最高國家:馬達加斯加(780例)、幾內亞(40例)、南蘇丹(37例)、剛果民主共和國(35例)、肯亞(27例)、賴比瑞亞(17例)。 全球近6週(4/6-5/17)共有19個國家報告 Ib型病毒:   社區傳播共15國:馬達加斯加(780例)、南蘇丹(37例)、剛果民主共和國(35例)、巴基斯坦(29例)、肯亞(27例)、西班牙(18例)、德國(17例)、瑞士(14例)、葛摩/葡萄牙(6例)、斯洛伐克/剛果共和國(4例)、哥倫比亞(3例)、泰國/丹麥(2例)。 與旅遊相關(境外移入)共4 國:美國(5 例)、模里西斯(2 例)、臺灣/愛爾蘭(1例)。
TrNrnQecC4af-YR-nwzsMQ.en: Monthly update: globally, since 2022 and as of 30 April this year, 144 countries and territories have reported 184,531 confirmed cases, of which at least 506 were fatal. In Africa, the countries reporting the most confirmed cases over the past six weeks (6 April–17 May) were Madagascar (780), Guinea (40), South Sudan (37), the DRC (35), Kenya (27) and Liberia (17). Globally, 19 countries have reported clade Ib virus over the past six weeks (6 April–17 May). Community transmission has been reported in 15 countries: Madagascar (780), South Sudan (37), DRC (35), Pakistan (29), Kenya (27), Spain (18), Germany (17), Switzerland (14), Comoros/Portugal (6), Slovakia/Republic of the Congo (4), Colombia (3), and Thailand/Denmark (2). Travel-associated (imported) cases have been reported in four countries: United States (5), Mauritius (2), and Taiwan/Ireland (1).

qKUxc6-Q6_UeTClgmVK8Jw.zh: 每月更新:  全球自2022年截至今年3/31累計144國/地區報告18萬2,945例確診病例,其中,至少503例死亡。 今年3月共計48國家/地區報告1,235 例新增確診病例,其中5例死亡(CFR 0.4%),70.4%的病例來自非洲地區,相較今年2月,東地中海及西太平洋區病例數上升,其餘地區疫情下降,哥倫比亞、丹麥、厄瓜多和新加坡通報首例 Ib 型病例。 非洲地區近6週(2026/3/9-4/19)共計16國通報969例確診病例,其中3例死亡(CFR 0.3%),以馬達加斯加、剛果民主共和國、幾內亞、肯亞、蒲隆地為高;非洲以外地區,阿根廷、丹麥、德國、巴基斯坦、葡萄牙、新加坡、西班牙及英國已持續出現Ib型社區傳播。 巴基斯坦信德省通報一起院內群聚事件(前已掌握),傳播原因主要為共用保溫箱、氧氣設備及設備表面受污染。在3至4月期間,該省9縣(/30縣)共29例確診與8例死亡(CFR 28%),死亡個案均為6個月以下嬰兒,基因定序確認為Ib型變異株。
qKUxc6-Q6_UeTClgmVK8Jw.en: Monthly update: globally, since 2022 and as of 31 March this year, 144 countries and territories have reported 182,945 confirmed cases cumulatively, of which at least 503 died. In March this year, 48 countries and territories reported 1,235 new confirmed cases, including five deaths (CFR 0.4%). 70.4% of cases came from the African region. Compared with February, cases rose in the Eastern Mediterranean and Western Pacific regions and fell in other regions. Colombia, Denmark, Ecuador and Singapore reported their first clade Ib cases. In the African region, over the past six weeks (9 March–19 April), 16 countries reported 969 confirmed cases, including three deaths (CFR 0.3%), with the highest numbers in Madagascar, the DRC, Guinea, Kenya and Burundi. Outside Africa, Argentina, Denmark, Germany, Pakistan, Portugal, Singapore, Spain and the United Kingdom have continued to show clade Ib community transmission. Sindh Province in Pakistan reported a hospital cluster (already known), with transmission mainly attributed to shared incubators and oxygen equipment and contaminated equipment surfaces. In March and April, the province's nine of 30 districts recorded 29 confirmed cases and eight deaths (CFR 28%). All deaths were in infants under six months, and genetic sequencing confirmed a clade Ib variant.

xrr80roC5ErMIg5Y4gLi1Q.zh: WHO美洲區更新流行病學報告,該區去年共計報告46,870例確定病例,低於2024年同期(66,184例),其中以美國病例數為多,共計報告28,783例確定(含疑)病例,以11-19歲年齡層為多,其次為秘魯(4,632例),另智利(3,387例)、巴西(2,682例)、墨西哥(1,596例)、阿根廷(1,210例)及哥倫比亞(1,178例)亦報告逾千例確定病例。另美國今年截至3/27已報告2,355例確定病例。
xrr80roC5ErMIg5Y4gLi1Q.en: The WHO Americas Region has updated its epidemiological report. The region reported 46,870 confirmed cases last year, lower than the 66,184 reported in the same period of 2024. The United States reported the most, with 28,783 confirmed (including suspected) cases, mainly among people aged 11–19 years. Peru followed with 4,632 cases, and Chile (3,387), Brazil (2,682), Mexico (1,596), Argentina (1,210) and Colombia (1,178) each also reported more than 1,000 confirmed cases. In addition, the United States had reported 2,355 confirmed cases so far this year as of 27 March.

NvS-hcBUZ5vJ-e-81vEZDg.zh: 美洲地區今年1-7週共4國累計34例確診病例及15例死亡(CFR:44%),分布於哥倫比亞(25例病例及13例死亡)、委內瑞拉(6例病例及1例死亡)、玻利維亞(1例死亡)及秘魯(2例病例)。自2024年9月以來,病例已發生於先前無疫情傳播地區,如亞馬遜雨林以外地區,泛美衛生組織(PAHO)發布警報,呼籲各國加強監測及疫苗接種等措施。
NvS-hcBUZ5vJ-e-81vEZDg.en: In the Americas, weeks 1–7 of this year, 4 countries reported a cumulative 34 confirmed cases and 15 deaths (CFR: 44%), distributed as follows: Colombia (25 cases and 13 deaths), Venezuela (6 cases and 1 death), Bolivia (1 death) and Peru (2 cases). Since September 2024, cases have occurred in areas with no previous transmission, including areas outside the Amazon rainforest. The Pan American Health Organization (PAHO) has issued an alert and called on countries to strengthen surveillance, vaccination and other measures.

n_mg488r_cGH0qAmkParzw.zh: 哥倫比亞自2024年迄今年1/26累計161例病例及73例死亡,於今 年1月即發生13例病例及10例死亡,顯示在無疫苗接種情況下,致死率極高。當局已加強健康警戒,再次呼籲民眾適時接種疫苗,並於風險地區採取防護措施。
n_mg488r_cGH0qAmkParzw.en: From 2024 to 26 January 2026, Colombia recorded 161 cases and 73 deaths. In January 2026 alone, 13 cases and 10 deaths were reported, indicating a very high case fatality rate in the absence of vaccination. Authorities have strengthened health alert measures, again urged timely vaccination, and called for protective measures in at-risk areas.

IKCpQgct8DXnQqB3uAr8Wg.zh: 哥倫比亞疫情持續,2025年共10省累計118例病例及49例死亡,其中,托利馬省自2024年爆發疫情後,已累計121例病例及47例死亡為多,病例主要為未接種疫苗且有疫情風險地區旅遊史者,由於假期人潮流動可能造成疫情上升,當局呼籲加強防治措施,以避免疾病傳播。
IKCpQgct8DXnQqB3uAr8Wg.en: Colombia's outbreak continues. In 2025, 118 cases and 49 deaths were reported cumulatively across 10 departments. Tolima department, where the outbreak began after 2024, has cumulatively recorded 121 cases and 47 deaths, the largest share. Cases are mainly among unvaccinated people with travel history to areas at risk of outbreaks. Because holiday travel may increase case numbers, authorities call for strengthened prevention and control measures to prevent the spread of disease.

0xGF5Q0WNSrT3oR8zcJtBw.zh: 美洲地區今年截至7月累計11國報告逾12,700例確診病例,其中,巴西、哥倫比亞、古巴、巴拿馬、秘魯及委內瑞拉均有報告本土病例,以往疫情主要分布於亞馬遜雨林地區,惟近2年已傳播至原流行區以外地區。泛美衛生組織(PAHO)針對美洲局部地區屈公病疫情及奧羅普切熱病例持續發生,於8/29呼籲美洲地區加強監測及病媒控制,將奧羅普切熱感染納入疑登革熱感染之鑑別診斷中,並提醒可能出現之神經系統併發症狀。
0xGF5Q0WNSrT3oR8zcJtBw.en: In the Americas, as of July this year, 11 countries had cumulatively reported more than 12,700 confirmed cases. Locally acquired cases have been reported in Brazil, Colombia, Cuba, Panama, Peru and Venezuela. Previous outbreaks were mainly in the Amazon rainforest region, but in the past two years the disease has spread beyond its original endemic areas. In view of continued chikungunya outbreaks in parts of the Americas and continued Oropouche cases, PAHO on 29 August called on the region to strengthen surveillance and vector control, to include Oropouche infection in the differential diagnosis of suspected dengue, and to be alert to possible neurological complications.

zekEQCwJMOQXY8FKV6j3Lg.zh: 美洲疫情更新,今年截至第30週共11國累計報告12,786例確診病例,其中,巴西11,888例(5例死亡)、巴拿馬501例、秘魯330例、古巴28例、哥倫比亞26例、委內瑞拉5例、蓋亞那1例、烏拉圭3例(境外移入)、智利2例(境外移入)、美國及加拿大各1例(境外移入)。受到氣候變遷等因素導致病媒─帕拉庫蠓孳生,進而造成病毒傳播至非流行地區(如古巴市區)。此外,英國亦報告3例病例,均有巴西旅遊史。去年美洲地區累計報告16,239例確診病例(4例死亡),歐洲地區亦報告30例境外移入病例。
zekEQCwJMOQXY8FKV6j3Lg.en: Americas outbreak update: as of week 30 this year, 11 countries had cumulatively reported 12,786 confirmed cases: Brazil 11,888 (5 deaths), Panama 501, Peru 330, Cuba 28, Colombia 26, Venezuela 5, Guyana 1, Uruguay 3 (imported), Chile 2 (imported), and the USA and Canada 1 each (imported). Climate change and other factors have led to proliferation of the vector, the Culicoides paraensis midge, which has spread the virus to non-endemic areas such as central Havana, Cuba. In addition, the UK reported three cases, all with travel history to Brazil. Last year, the Americas cumulatively reported 16,239 confirmed cases (4 deaths), and Europe also reported 30 imported cases.

k422FmmOJ-Ac_bIIosZw6A.zh: PAHO於5/31發布百日咳流病警報,美洲7國病例數呈上升趨勢,其中,以美國逾1萬例病例及5例死亡最為嚴峻,餘有巴西/墨西哥/厄瓜多/祕魯/哥倫比亞/巴拉圭,病例數在37-1,634例間。該地區於2012年病例數達高峰後,持續下降,惟於2023年開始上升,去年報告4.4萬例,病例數增加與新冠疫情期間疫苗覆蓋率下降相關,PAHO呼籲各國加強監測及加強疫苗接種等措施。 日本疫情持續,近1週(5/19-25)通報2,660例,較前1週2,299例增加360餘例,持續創2018年以來新高,新增病例數以新潟縣(148)為多,其次為兵庫縣(139)。今年迄今已累計逾2.2萬例,並有報告嬰兒重症及死亡案例,專家表示此次疫情嚴峻與易感性族群增加相關,由於疫情期間防護措施,導致對多種呼吸道傳染病免疫力下降,且抗藥性菌株於去年秋天以來持續傳播。今年報告2例未達接種月齡之新生兒死亡病例,且此次疫情集中於10多歲青少年族群,建議常與家中嬰幼兒接觸之家庭成員接種疫苗。
k422FmmOJ-Ac_bIIosZw6A.en: PAHO issued a pertussis epidemic alert on 31 May. Among seven countries in the Americas where case numbers are rising, the United States is the most severe, with more than 10,000 cases and 5 deaths. The others are Brazil, Mexico, Ecuador, Peru, Colombia and Paraguay, with case numbers ranging from 37 to 1,634. After peaking in 2012, case numbers in the region continued to decline, but they have risen since 2023, with 44,000 cases reported last year. The increase is associated with declining vaccination coverage during the COVID-19 pandemic. PAHO urges countries to strengthen surveillance and vaccination measures. Japan's outbreak continues: in the most recent week (19–25 May), 2,660 cases were reported, an increase of more than 360 from 2,299 the previous week, a continued high since 2018. Niigata Prefecture had the most new cases (148), followed by Hyogo Prefecture (139). So far this year, more than 22,000 cases have been reported cumulatively, and severe cases and deaths among infants have been reported. Experts say the severity of this outbreak is linked to an increase in susceptible populations: protective measures during the pandemic reduced immunity to several respiratory infectious diseases, and drug-resistant strains have continued to spread since last autumn. This year, two newborns too young to be vaccinated have died; the outbreak is concentrated among teenagers, and family members who often have contact with infants and young children at home are advised to get vaccinated.

5CH4oLH2x-o_k4TLimkPSw.zh: 美洲地區疫情更新,今年截至第20週累計221例病例(89例死亡),今年病例數約為去年同期27例之8倍,分布於巴西、哥倫比亞、秘魯、玻利維亞及厄瓜多,去年病例主要分布於亞馬遜雨林地區,惟今年已傳播至前揭地區以外之巴西聖保羅州及哥倫比亞托利馬省,且以未接種疫苗個案為多,評估美洲地區(尤其流行國家)風險為高。
5CH4oLH2x-o_k4TLimkPSw.en: Americas regional update: as of week 20 this year, 221 cases (89 deaths) have been reported cumulatively. This year's case count is about eight times the 27 cases reported in the same period last year. Cases are distributed in Brazil, Colombia, Peru, Bolivia and Ecuador. Last year's cases were mainly in the Amazon rainforest region, but this year the disease has spread beyond those areas, to São Paulo State in Brazil and Tolima Department in Colombia, and most cases were unvaccinated. The risk for the Americas, especially in endemic countries, is assessed as high.

t3DAtQl1P2Ja5yZeLXnxnw.zh: 哥倫比亞宣布衛生緊急狀態,今年截至4/13已通報57例確診病例,22例死亡,致死率估計逾40%,病例以中西部托利馬省為多,該地區自2007年後未曾報告病例,另有6隻靈長類動物感染黃熱病死亡,評估該國目前有388個城市面臨高風險,並有擴散至鄰國包括秘魯和玻利維亞之風險。當局已針對前往高風險地區旅客實施強制接種疫苗措施。
t3DAtQl1P2Ja5yZeLXnxnw.en: Colombia has declared a health emergency. As of 13 April this year, 57 confirmed cases and 22 deaths have been reported, with an estimated case fatality rate above 40%. Cases are concentrated in Tolima Department in the central-west, an area where no cases had been reported since 2007. In addition, 6 primates have died of yellow fever. Authorities assess that 388 cities in the country are at high risk, and that the disease may spread to neighboring countries including Peru and Bolivia. Authorities have made vaccination mandatory for travelers to high-risk areas.

ErDra58MMvPIBu-RjQqq_A.zh: 泛美衛生組織(PAHO)發布警報,美洲近期病例數上升,2025年迄第12週累計131例病例及53例死亡,分布於巴西81例病例(31例死亡)、哥倫比亞31例病例(13例死亡)、秘魯18例病例(8例死亡)及玻利維亞1例死亡病例,大部分病例均未接種疫苗,2024年病例主要分布於亞馬遜雨林地區,惟2025年已傳播至前揭地區以外之區域。
ErDra58MMvPIBu-RjQqq_A.en: The Pan American Health Organization (PAHO) has issued an alert over rising yellow fever cases in the Americas. Through week 12 of 2025, 131 cases and 53 deaths have been reported cumulatively: Brazil 81 cases (31 deaths), Colombia 31 cases (13 deaths), Peru 18 cases (8 deaths) and one fatal case in Bolivia. Most cases were unvaccinated. In 2024, cases were mainly in the Amazon rainforest region, but in 2025 transmission has spread beyond those areas.

Tud7g56VOxcWb_MwISrwaQ.zh: 哥倫比亞疫情更新,自2024年疫情截至今年2/21累計40例病例及19例死亡(CFR:47%),截至今年3月中旬,托利馬省、卡克塔省、烏伊拉省、納里奧省、普圖馬約省、沃佩斯省之疫情仍持續;南美洲在2024年至今年已累計61例病例,其中19例死亡(CFR:49%)。
Tud7g56VOxcWb_MwISrwaQ.en: Colombia update: from the 2024 outbreak to 21 February this year, 40 cases and 19 deaths (CFR: 47%) have been reported cumulatively. As of mid-March this year, outbreaks continue in the departments of Tolima, Caquetá, Huila, Nariño, Putumayo and Vaupés. Across South America, 61 cases, of which 19 were fatal (CFR: 49%), have been reported cumulatively from 2024 to date.

JRj0JYSEysFGKKVcb3SVYg.zh: 阿根廷疫情更新,今年截至2/27累計報告288例病例,去年全年共報告564例病例;去年美洲地區以巴西、阿根廷、玻利維亞、哥倫比亞等國病例數為多,其中巴西報告42,000餘例病例。
JRj0JYSEysFGKKVcb3SVYg.en: Argentina update: as of 27 February this year, 288 cases have been reported cumulatively, compared with 564 cases for the whole of last year. Last year, case numbers in the Americas were highest in Brazil, Argentina, Bolivia, Colombia and other countries; Brazil reported over 42,000 cases.

6EBBkB1YhV46yErhnWn6Zg.zh: 美洲疫情上升,泛美衛生組織(PAHO)於2/4對美洲近期病例數上升發布警報,今年1月已報告17例病例及7例死亡。2024年累計61例病例及30例死亡,高於2022-2023年玻利維亞、巴西、哥倫比亞及秘魯等國之病例數及死亡數;2024年病例主要分布於亞馬遜雨林地區,包括玻利維亞、巴西、哥倫比亞、蓋亞那及秘魯等國,今年疾病傳播至該地區以外的區域,主要分布於巴西聖保羅州、哥倫比亞托利馬省等地區;該組織呼籲加強疫苗接種措施及疫情監測。
6EBBkB1YhV46yErhnWn6Zg.en: Cases are rising in the Americas. On 4 February, the Pan American Health Organization (PAHO) issued an alert over the recent increase in cases in the region. In January this year, 17 cases and 7 deaths were reported. In 2024, 61 cases and 30 deaths were reported cumulatively, higher than the case and death numbers for 2022–2023 in countries including Bolivia, Brazil, Colombia and Peru. Cases in 2024 were mainly in the Amazon rainforest region, including Bolivia, Brazil, Colombia, Guyana and Peru. This year, the disease has spread beyond that region, mainly to areas including São Paulo State in Brazil and Tolima Department in Colombia. The organization calls for strengthened vaccination and disease surveillance.

Authorities continue to run awareness campaigns and take control measures. Colombia update: a serotype 2 dengue outbreak has broken out in Huila Department in the southwest, and authorities have declared a public health emergency. Colombia has recorded over 19,000 cases cumulatively so far in 2025.

r6FgADjZggwIUNilx63u-A.en: Global update: Last year, up to November, over 14 million cases and 10,000 deaths were reported worldwide. Cases were mainly in the Region of the Americas, which reported over 12.5 million cases and 7,000 deaths, with Brazil reporting over 10 million cases, followed by Argentina, Mexico, Colombia and Paraguay. Australia update: Townsville in Queensland State in the northeast reported one case, the city's first locally acquired case in five years.

5Le7wF2JlCuYzShdrD6Bzg.en: Americas update: As of 25 November this year, 11,634 cases have been cumulatively reported, including 2 deaths, both from Brazil. A total of 11 countries/territories have reported cases: Brazil (9,563), Peru (936), Cuba (603), Bolivia (356), Colombia (74), Ecuador (2), Guyana (2) and Panama (1). The United States (94), Canada (2) and the British overseas territory of the Cayman Islands (1) have also reported cases, all of them imported. In addition, Brazil has reported confirmed cases of vertical transmission. WHO assesses the public health risk of the virus as high for the region and low for the world.

gIXMmj2cpoTQY5E7tZKH0Q.en: Colombia update: As of 2 November this year, 110,343 cases have been cumulatively reported, about 80% higher than the same period last year. Plasmodium vivax infections account for the majority, at 61.9%. Cases are mainly concentrated in Chocó Department in the northwest (35.4%). In the Americas, malaria is mainly prevalent in the Amazon rainforest and in rural and jungle areas of several neighbouring countries, including Brazil, Colombia, Venezuela and Peru.

yS6IQ5shKM7ev5YL1T8byQ.en: Colombia update: As of 7 November this year, 26 cases have been cumulatively reported, mainly in Tolima Department in west-central Colombia, and authorities have implemented vaccination measures. As of week 35 this year, the Region of the Americas has reported 38 confirmed cases, including 19 deaths. Cases are mainly distributed in Colombia, Bolivia, Peru, Brazil and Guyana.

3S2aQDaVh5BvsnutA2kgKg.en:
Colombia: In Tolima Department in west-central Colombia, 1 death was reported on 29 October, in a 47-year-old man. Authorities have adopted relevant prevention and control measures.

Guinea: In Labé Region in north-central Guinea, 2 cases were reported on 2 November, a 15-year-old and a 24-year-old woman; one of them was pregnant. Both developed symptoms in mid-September, were sampled on 5 October and confirmed on 8 October. Africa has cumulatively reported 703 cases and 6 deaths as of 26 October.

unoWzrixICQQwjn7hG4dqw.en:
Global update: So far this year, more than 13 million cases and 8,500 deaths have been cumulatively reported globally.

Americas: Case numbers are highest in Brazil, followed by Argentina, Mexico, Paraguay and Colombia.

Europe: France, Italy and Spain have reported cases.

Eastern Mediterranean: Iran, Afghanistan and Pakistan have reported cases.

South-East Asia: Case numbers rose in Bangladesh and Nepal. In the Indian states of Kerala and Karnataka, cases this year are higher than in the same period last year. Case numbers in Indonesia declined.

Western Pacific: Case numbers rose in China and Viet Nam and fell in Cambodia.

Africa: The Central African Republic announced an outbreak in mid-September, and cases in Togo also rose.
